name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven po aktualnim reasoning UX rezu a download metadata byla srovnana s lokalnim setup buildem 0.1.460.
changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt after the current reasoning UX slice and download metadata was aligned with the local 0.1.460 setup build.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven po aktualnim reasoning UX rezu a download metadata byla srovnana s lokalnim setup buildem 0.1.460.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt after the current reasoning UX slice and download metadata was aligned with the local 0.1.460 setup build.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri volani modelu pouziva explicitni stav Premyslim s animovanym WDUi ShimmerText a po dokonceni modeloveho streamu ho spolehlive vypina, aby chat nepusobil jako tichy nebo technicky log.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now uses an explicit Reasoning state with animated WDUi ShimmerText during model calls and reliably clears it after the model stream completes, so chat does not feel silent or like a technical log.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zprisnuje project-intake guard: klikaci start projektu musi dodat tri kroky a JarvisAction navrhy, jinak odpoved opravi nebo nahradi bezpecnym fallbackem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tightens the project-intake guard: one-click project start must provide three steps and JarvisAction suggestions, otherwise the answer is repaired or replaced with a safe fallback.

history.changes_cs: Rebuild Jarvise s aktualni WDUi knihovnou a znovu publikovanym setup/update balikem.
history.changes_en: Rebuild Jarvis with the current WDUi library and republish the setup/update package.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zpresnuje project-intake guard podle realne spatne konverzace: blokuje kodovy vystup, reseni ukazkoveho TODO a ptani se uzivatele na projekt, kdyz uz ma podklady.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tightens the project-intake guard based on a real bad transcript: it blocks code output, sample TODO solving, and asking the user to explain the project when evidence is already available.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis chrani projektovy start pred odbocenim do ukazkovych ukolu ze zdrojaku a kontroluje project-intake odpoved pred zobrazenim.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now guards project intake against drifting into sample tasks from project files and validates the answer before showing it.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven a publikovan s aktualnimi CPM a WDUi zmenami.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt and published with current CPM and WDUi changes.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven s aktualnim obsahem bundled skills a aktualni WDUi knihovnou.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt with the current bundled skills content and the latest WDUi library.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri uvazovani modelu zobrazuje animovane 'Premysli' primo v chatu a WDUi ma novy skinovatelny ShimmerText control.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now shows an animated thinking indicator while the model is reasoning, backed by a reusable skinnable WDUi ShimmerText control.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma oddeleny WorkerQueue modul pro frontu prace, presuny, prioritu a snapshoty. Smoke test nově overuje frontu samostatnym self-testem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a separate WorkerQueue module for the work queue, reordering, priority, and snapshots. Smoke tests now cover the queue with a dedicated self-test.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v Modularization Tracku: detekce aktivniho a sledovaneho stahovani modelu se presunula z Jarvis.cpp do JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp. App shell si nechava jen kompatibilni wrappery, zatimco service vlastni snapshot aktivniho pozadavku, active-vs-queue tracking a self-testy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues the Modularization Track: active and tracked model-download detection moved from Jarvis.cpp into JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp. The app shell keeps only compatibility wrappers while the service owns active request snapshots, active-vs-queue tracking, and self-test coverage.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v Modularization Tracku: lockovane progress a finish mutace stavu stahovani modelu se presunuly z Jarvis.cpp do JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp. App shell uz jen odesila WDUi progress message, zatimco service vlastni konzistentni stavovy zapis a jeho self-test.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues the Modularization Track: locked progress and finish mutations for model-download state moved from Jarvis.cpp into JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp. The app shell now only posts the WDUi progress message while the service owns consistent state writes and their self-test coverage.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v Modularization Tracku: self-test ModelDownloadService se presunul z Jarvis.cpp primo do JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp, takze service nese vlastni deterministickou verifikaci queue, dialog projection a completion kontraktu a app shell zustava uzsi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues the Modularization Track: the ModelDownloadService self-test moved from Jarvis.cpp directly into JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp, so the service owns deterministic verification of its queue, dialog projection, and completion contracts while the app shell stays narrower.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v Modularization Tracku: ModelDownloadService ted prebira UI-neutralni snapshot/projection logiku dialogu stahovani modelu a completion prechody pro pauzu, uspech a selhani; Jarvis.cpp zustava u WDUi controlu, vlakna a owner-facing orchestrace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues the Modularization Track: ModelDownloadService now owns the UI-neutral snapshot/projection logic for the model download dialog and completion transitions for pause, success, and failure; Jarvis.cpp remains responsible for WDUi controls, threads, and owner-facing orchestration.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v Modularization Tracku: ModelDownloadService ted drzi UI-neutralni frontu stahovani modelu vcetne canonicalizace, deduplikace, pause stavu, snapshotu, load/pop/push chovani a perzistence; dialog a vlakna zustavaji v shellu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues the Modularization Track: ModelDownloadService now owns the UI-neutral model-download queue, including canonicalization, dedupe, paused state, snapshots, load/pop/push behavior, and persistence; dialog and thread orchestration remain in the shell.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis posunul Modularization Track: ModelDownloadService ted drzi persisted download queue item serializaci/parsing, prazdnou frontu neuklada jako paused stav a self-test pokryva restartovou queue toleranci.
history.changes_en: Jarvis advanced the Modularization Track: ModelDownloadService now owns persisted download queue item serialization/parsing, avoids writing empty paused queue state, and self-tests cover restart queue tolerance.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis posunul Modularization Track: pridal JarvisModelDownloadService pro neutralni Ollama model download progress, byte/speed formatovani a bootstrap pull wrapper; smoke pokryva novy self-test.
history.changes_en: Jarvis advanced the Modularization Track: added JarvisModelDownloadService for UI-neutral Ollama model download progress, byte/speed formatting, and bootstrap pull wrapping; smoke now covers the new self-test.

history.changes_cs: Modularizace: interpretace odpovedi router modelu se presunula do JarvisPromptContextPlanneru; self-test hlida JSON odpoved routeru, reasoning upgrade a ochranu project-intake proti downgrade.
history.changes_en: Modularization: router model response interpretation moved into JarvisPromptContextPlanner; the self-test covers router JSON response parsing, reasoning upgrade, and project-intake downgrade protection.

history.changes_cs: Modularizace: report /suggest-context se presunul do JarvisPromptContextPlanneru; self-test hlida format navrzenych zdroju, attach rady, tokeny a statistiky skenu.
history.changes_en: Modularization: /suggest-context report construction moved into JarvisPromptContextPlanner; the self-test covers suggested source formatting, attach guidance, tokens, and scan statistics.

history.changes_cs: Modularizace: router prompt se presunul do JarvisPromptContextPlanneru a self-test hlida klasifikacni kontrakt, fallback route, profily, pocty kontextu a aktualni dotaz uzivatele.
history.changes_en: Modularization: router prompt construction moved into JarvisPromptContextPlanner, with a self-test covering the classification contract, fallback route, profiles, context counts, and current user request.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis presouva hlavni ordinary chat prompt do PromptContextPlanner. Jarvis.cpp uz jen mapuje job a kontext do ChatPromptInput; self-test hlida chatovy ton, skryti routing/provider detailu a PowerShell/Git Bash/WSL capability wording.
history.changes_en: Jarvis moves the main ordinary chat prompt into PromptContextPlanner. Jarvis.cpp now maps the job and context into ChatPromptInput; the self-test verifies chat tone, hidden routing/provider details, and PowerShell/Git Bash/WSL capability wording.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis rozsiruje PromptContextPlanner o context-compress prompt. /context-compress uz nesklada pravidla pro context pack primo v Jarvis.cpp; self-test hlida, ze kompresni prompt zachova pripojene soubory, Source N metadata a fokus uzivatele.
history.changes_en: Jarvis extends PromptContextPlanner with the context-compress prompt. /context-compress no longer builds context-pack rules directly in Jarvis.cpp; the self-test verifies the compression prompt preserves attached files, Source N metadata, and the user focus.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis rozsiruje PromptContextPlanner o source-answer prompt. /source-answer uz nesklada citacni Source N instrukce primo v Jarvis.cpp; self-test hlida, ze odpoved zustava jen ze zdroju, vyzaduje Source N citace a pri chybejicich dukazech nema hadat.
history.changes_en: Jarvis extends PromptContextPlanner with the source-answer prompt. /source-answer no longer builds Source N citation instructions directly in Jarvis.cpp; the self-test verifies answers stay source-only, require Source N citations, and do not guess when evidence is missing.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis rozsiruje PromptContextPlanner o single-file explain/review prompty. /explain a /review-file uz neskladaji modelovy prompt primo v Jarvis.cpp; novy self-test hlida, ze odpoved zustava ohranicena jednim souborem a review neprejde do navrhu patche bez pozadani.
history.changes_en: Jarvis extends PromptContextPlanner with single-file explain/review prompts. /explain and /review-file no longer build the model prompt directly in Jarvis.cpp; the new self-test verifies the answer stays bounded to one file and review mode does not propose patches unless asked.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis presunul project-intake prompt a ochranu pred ukazkovymi ukoly ze zdrojaku do samostatneho PromptContextPlanner modulu a pridal self-test, ktery hlida, ze aktualni dotaz uzivatele ma prednost pred obsahem projektu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis moved project-intake prompt construction and the source-sample-task guard into a standalone PromptContextPlanner module and added a self-test that verifies the current user request stays above project file content.

history.changes_cs: JarvisOllamaProvider ted sklada Ollama /api/generate URL a JSON body vcetne vision images payloadu; smoke test overuje provider request kontrakt.
history.changes_en: JarvisOllamaProvider now builds the Ollama /api/generate URL and JSON body, including vision image payloads; smoke tests cover the provider request contract.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis presunul Ollama chat/generate stream parser do provider modulu a zmensil hlavni worker streamovani.
history.changes_en: Jarvis moved the Ollama chat/generate stream parser into the provider module and reduced main worker streaming code.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis sjednotil Ollama /api/pull stream parser pro bootstrap, auto-pull i dialog stahovani modelu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis unified the Ollama /api/pull stream parser for bootstrap, auto-pull, and the model download dialog.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis oddelil prvni cast Ollama provideru do JarvisOllamaProvider.h/.cpp: endpoint, health/tag check, pull-status text, model matching a hledani Ollama exe/app jsou mimo hlavni shell.
history.changes_en: Jarvis split the first Ollama provider helpers into JarvisOllamaProvider.h/.cpp: endpoint handling, health/tag checks, pull-status wording, model matching, and Ollama exe/app discovery now live outside the main shell.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma oddeleny HTTP modul pro modelove, update, webove a extension volani. Hlavni Jarvis.cpp je mensi a HTTP prace se bude lepe delit do UpdateService/OllamaProvider.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a separate HTTP module for model, update, web, and extension calls. The main Jarvis.cpp is smaller and HTTP work is easier to split into UpdateService/OllamaProvider.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma oddeleny WorkerJournal modul pro app log, process-launch log a per-job trace zaznamy. Zmensuje hlavni Jarvis.cpp a pripravuje dalsi inkrementalni modularizaci workeru/provideru.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a separate WorkerJournal module for app logging, process-launch logging, and per-job trace records. This reduces the main Jarvis.cpp surface and prepares the next worker/provider modularization slices.

history.changes_cs: JarvisModelCatalog prevzal knihovnu modelu, profily vyberu, odhad HW fitu a doporucovaci hvezdicky mimo hlavni shell.
history.changes_en: JarvisModelCatalog now owns the model library, picker profiles, hardware-fit estimates, and recommendation stars outside the main shell.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje Jarvis update manifest a historii verzi do samostatne sluzby, presouva sdilene JSON/version helpery do JarvisText a opravuje WDUi event build.
history.changes_en: Splits Jarvis update manifest and version history into a separate service, moves shared JSON/version helpers into JarvisText, and fixes the WDUi event build.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v modularizaci: registr projektovych slozek a vypocet dostupnych projektu se presunuly do samostatneho modulu JarvisProjectStore, zatimco sidebar a dialogy zustavaji v UI shellu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues modularization: registered project roots and available project list construction moved into the JarvisProjectStore module while the sidebar and dialogs remain in the UI shell.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v modularizaci: metadata a index konverzaci se presunuly do samostatneho modulu JarvisConversationStore, zatimco UI seznamy a dialogy zustavaji v shellu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues modularization: conversation metadata and index persistence moved into the JarvisConversationStore module while sidebar lists and dialogs remain in the shell.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis presunul nacitani a ukladani konfigurace do samostatneho modulu JarvisSettings, doplnil WDUi event modul do buildu a zavedl pravidlo, ze hotove Jarvis ukoly maji strucny CPM Task Board report.
history.changes_en: Jarvis moved config load/save into the JarvisSettings module, added the WDUi event module to the build, and added the rule that completed Jarvis tasks leave a concise CPM Task Board report.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje Jarvisuv prototyp o prvni nastaveni modul: AppConfig a vychozi vyber lokalnich modelu se presouvaji mimo hlavni Jarvis.cpp. Build fingerprint ma fallback bez Get-FileHash.
history.changes_en: Splits the Jarvis prototype with a first settings module: AppConfig and hardware-aware default local model selection move out of the main Jarvis.cpp. Build fingerprinting now has a fallback when Get-FileHash is unavailable.

history.changes_cs: Rozdeluje Jarvisovy per-user cesty a app datove adresare do samostatneho modulu JarvisPaths a doplnuje zdrojovy architektonicky index, aby dalsi prace nevracela kod zpet do monolitu.
history.changes_en: Splits Jarvis per-user paths and app data directories into a separate JarvisPaths module and adds a source architecture index so future work keeps moving away from the monolith.

history.changes_cs: Opraveno orezani rohu vlastnich WDUi oken se zaoblenym skinem: custom-frame okna ted automaticky pouziji region podle nerektángloveho povrchu, takze za hornim rameckem nezustavaji rohove pixely.
history.changes_en: Fixed custom WDUi window corner clipping for rounded skins: custom-frame windows now automatically use a native region for non-rectangular surfaces, so stray corner pixels do not remain behind the top frame.

history.changes_cs: Optimalizuje Jarvis build a textove helpery: aplikační cpp soubory se objevuji automaticky, build nema rucni vyjimky pro nove prekladove jednotky a porovnavani textu bez ohledu na velikost pismen uz nevytvari zbytecne kopie retezcu.
history.changes_en: Optimizes Jarvis build and text helpers: application cpp sources are discovered automatically, the build no longer needs manual exceptions for new translation units, and case-insensitive text comparison no longer creates unnecessary string copies.
